description: Plain-language Termination Media IP routing, watchlist alerts, failures, and individual CDR details.

panels.description: Checks all ingested history, independent of the selected dashboard time range and filters. CLEAR means no watched IP has ever appeared as term_media_ip. ALERT means at least one has appeared. NOT CONFIGURED means the server watchlist is empty.

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT count() FROM cdr.termination_media_ip_watchlist) AS configured SELECT multiIf(configured = 0, -1, toInt64(uniqExact(termination_media_ip))) AS `Watched IP Status` FROM cdr.termination_media_ip_watch_hits FINAL

panels.title: WATCHED IP ALERT

panels.description: Every exact route in all ingested history where a watched IP appeared as term_media_ip. This table is independent of dashboard time and route filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT termination_media_ip AS `Termination Media IP`, min(hour) AS `First Seen`, max(hour) AS `Last Seen`, entity AS `CDR Source`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Customer Trunk`, term_carrier_name AS `Termination Vendor`, term_trunk_group_name AS `Termination Trunk`, term_ip AS `Termination Signaling IP`, sum(matching_cdrs) AS `Matching CDRs` FROM cdr.termination_media_ip_watch_hits FINAL GROUP BY termination_media_ip, entity, orig_trunk_group_name, term_carrier_name, term_trunk_group_name, term_ip ORDER BY `Last Seen` DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Watched Termination Media IP Matches

panels.description: One row is one exact termination route. No vendors, trunks, or IPs are combined into lists.

targets.rawSql: SELECT entity AS `CDR Source`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Customer Trunk`, term_carrier_name AS `Termination Vendor`, term_trunk_group_name AS `Termination Trunk`, term_ip AS `Termination Signaling IP`, term_media_ip AS `Termination Media IP`, max(hour) AS `Last Seen`, sum(attempts) AS CDRs, sum(completions) AS Answered, sum(attempts) - sum(completions) AS Failed, round(100.0 * sum(completions) / nullIf(sum(attempts), 0), 2) AS `Answer Rate` FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND term_media_ip != '(none)' AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) GROUP BY entity, orig_trunk_group_name, term_carrier_name, term_trunk_group_name, term_ip, term_media_ip ORDER BY CDRs DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Termination Route Map

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, sum(attempts) AS `CDRs`, sum(completions) AS `Answered` FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND term_media_ip != '(none)' AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

panels.title: Termination Media IP Activity by Hour

panels.description: The most active Termination Media IP routes in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT term_media_ip AS `Termination Media IP`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Trunk`, term_carrier_name AS Vendor, term_trunk_group_name AS `Termination Trunk`, max(hour) AS `Last Seen`, sum(attempts) AS CDRs FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND term_media_ip != '(none)' AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) GROUP BY term_media_ip, orig_trunk_group_name, term_carrier_name, term_trunk_group_name ORDER BY CDRs DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Most Used Termination Media IPs

panels.description: Non-200 SIP responses grouped by the exact termination route.

targets.rawSql: SELECT term_media_ip AS `Termination Media IP`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Customer Trunk`, term_carrier_name AS `Termination Vendor`, term_trunk_group_name AS `Termination Trunk`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, reason AS `Release Reason`, sum(attempts) AS `Failed CDRs` FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND term_media_ip != '(none)' AND sip_code != 200 AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) GROUP BY term_media_ip, orig_trunk_group_name, term_carrier_name, term_trunk_group_name, sip_code, reason ORDER BY `Failed CDRs` DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Failures by Termination Media IP Route

panels.description: Individual CDRs with customer-side routing followed by termination-side routing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT call_start_time AS `Call Started`, call_end_time AS `Call Ended`, entity AS `CDR Source`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Customer Trunk`, orig_carrier_name AS `Customer Carrier`, term_carrier_name AS `Termination Vendor`, term_trunk_group_name AS `Termination Trunk`, term_ip AS `Termination Signaling IP`, term_media_ip AS `Termination Media IP`, from_did AS `From Number`, to_did AS `To Number`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, if(sip_code = 200, 'Answered', 'Failed') AS Result, coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided') AS `Release Reason`, duration_real AS `Duration Sec`, orig_billed_duration AS `Billable Sec`, stir_attest AS Attestation, round(mos_avg, 2) AS MOS, callid AS `Call ID` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND notEmpty(term_media_ip) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Individual CDRs (latest 1,000)

targets.rawSql: SELECT entity AS `CDR Source`, file_hour AS `File Hour`, file_path AS File, status AS Status, message AS Message, rows_ingested AS Rows, updated_at AS Updated FROM cdr.ingest_log FINAL WHERE status IN ('error', 'changed') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100
